what: Dragging over the panel draws a hand-drawn map — an ink coastline with wobbling thickness and an echo line 15px to the side (new points follow 0.4s later), trees scattered along the path that pop up with elastic, mountains that rise with back.out(4), castles·houses·towers that drop with bounce where tapped, and dotted roads whose endpoints join within 15px

options.tool: coast (default)·tree·mountain·building·route — re-read on every press, so the toolbar only needs to change the tool in data-fx-ink-map
options.closed: If false, the coastline is not closed (closed by default)
options.round: If true, trees get a round crown (default is pointed)
options.size: Mountain size sm·md·lg (.7·1·1.4 times, spacing 40~65 scales along)
options.fx:clear: Send this event to the element to clear everything

note: The original is a paper.js canvas. The same numbers were moved to SVG, with Catmull-Rom and Douglas-Peucker instead of smooth()/simplify() and hand-written gradient noise instead of simplex, so the curve texture differs slightly.
